name: School Learning
overview: Explore curriculum planning and age-appropriate study strategies.
practice: Follow official local syllabuses for examination scope.

name: Mathematics
overview: Review equations, arithmetic and quantitative reasoning.
practice: Check solution steps and units instead of memorizing answers.

name: Science Learning
overview: Explore practical concepts from biology, chemistry and physics.
practice: Separate demonstrations from controlled experiments.

name: English Learning
overview: Build vocabulary, reading and communication routines.
practice: Practice comprehension rather than isolated word lists.

name: Coding Fundamentals
overview: Understand variables, conditions, functions and debugging.
practice: Learn by testing small programs with clear expected outputs.

name: Digital Literacy
overview: Develop reliable search, privacy and productivity skills.
practice: Verify sources before sharing online information.

name: GPA Calculator
overview: Calculate credit-weighted grade points on a stated scale.
practice: Confirm school conversion rules and whether retakes count.

name: CGPA Planning
overview: Understand cumulative performance across semesters.
practice: Check credit weighting and institutional rounding rules.

name: Exam Preparation
overview: Plan revision schedules, question practice and retrieval.
practice: Use official exam format and time constraints.

name: Study Planner
overview: Balance subjects, deadlines and recovery time.
practice: Prioritize weak areas based on performance evidence.

name: Academic Writing
overview: Understand citation, structure and revision.
practice: Attribute sources and avoid plagiarism.

name: Research Skills
overview: Learn search strategy, evidence assessment and referencing.
practice: Separate peer-reviewed research from marketing claims.

name: Scholarships
overview: Explore eligibility, documents and funding terms.
practice: Verify deadlines and official awarding institutions.

name: Study Abroad
overview: Understand course choice, admission and funding processes.
practice: Check visa requirements with destination authorities.

name: Universities & Courses
overview: Compare programs, accreditation and total cost.
practice: Confirm recognition and outcomes rather than rankings alone.

name: Online Courses
overview: Explore self-paced learning and assessment formats.
practice: Check instructor credentials and certification terms.

name: Professional Certifications
overview: Plan certification tracks and exam readiness.
practice: Verify vendor versions and renewal requirements.

name: Language Tests
overview: Understand test formats, scoring and preparation methods.
practice: Use official practice materials for current specifications.

name: Government Jobs
overview: Explore recruitment processes and eligibility screening.
practice: Rely on official notices for deadlines and fees.

name: Private Sector Careers
overview: Learn roles, core competencies and hiring processes.
practice: Compare job descriptions against demonstrable skills.

name: Remote Work
overview: Understand distributed-team expectations and job verification.
practice: Watch for advance-fee recruitment scams.

name: Freelancing
overview: Explore service packaging, client communication and contracts.
practice: Track project time, fees, contract scope and payment risk before accepting client work.

name: Internships
overview: Plan experience building and application preparation.
practice: Check supervision, compensation and learning objectives.

name: Career Change
overview: Map transferable skills and realistic training paths.
practice: Validate hiring demand with recent job postings.

name: Job Market Skills
overview: Understand technical and human skill combinations.
practice: Review role-level requirements rather than generic trends.

name: CV Builder Guide
overview: Organize achievements, experience and relevant keywords.
practice: Use truthful, measurable accomplishments and accessible formatting.

name: Interview Preparation
overview: Practice technical examples and behavioral responses.
practice: Prepare evidence for claims and questions for the employer.

name: Portfolio Projects
overview: Showcase work samples with scope and outcomes.
practice: Include tests, documentation and a clear contribution statement.

name: Skill Assessment
overview: Assess strengths and development priorities.
practice: Use representative tasks instead of arbitrary scores.

name: Career Learning Roadmap
overview: Build staged learning goals and milestone checks.
practice: Revisit the plan as experience and market demand change.
